title: Furniture importer in Los Angeles
assumptions: A brand importing upholstered furniture into Los Angeles and selling it from a warehouse, answering the intake: doesn't manufacture, sells upholstered pieces, no children's products, not online. The furniture filings are those of the furniture set's la-upholstered-importer case; beyond them, the plan states the labels a California importer's goods carry, origin marking, and the tariff classification as CBP's to decide.

items.note: $20 filing fee; a certified copy is $5 more. Filing late can bring a $250 penalty.
